summary: Targeted frontend retest completed. The user and developer CTA/banner dark-mode contrast fix passes in live runtime and is present in the packaged CSS. User dashboard dark-mode text and all three tabs pass; homepage light-mode sanity and yarn build pass. Deployment packaging regressed by embedding the public preview backend URL, and the brand-blue CTA buttons remain below WCAG AA contrast for normal text.

integration_issues.issue: production-hostinger-ready.zip embeds https://realtor-uploader.preview.emergentagent.com in frontend/build/static/js/main.70539878.js. A deployment made from this archive will send API traffic to the preview environment instead of same-origin /api; this regresses the iteration_7 package fix.

design_issues.screen: User and developer dashboard CTA banners
issues: White 14px button text on the computed brand-blue #708DE6 background has approximately 3.16:1 contrast, below the WCAG AA 4.5:1 requirement for normal text. The buttons are visible and the reported white-on-white card defect is fixed, but the button color should be darkened for AA compliance.

action_items: Rebuild the deployment frontend with an empty/same-origin REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and regenerate production-hostinger-ready.zip; confirm the preview domain count in packaged JS is zero while retaining the two dark gradient rules.
Use a darker blue for the dashboard CTA buttons, or otherwise raise white-text contrast from 3.16:1 to at least 4.5:1.
critical_code_review_comments: The new .dark .from-blue-50 and .dark .to-white rules are correctly ordered and work at runtime: both dashboards compute a dark gradient from rgba(112, 141, 230, 0.14) to #1C3833, with white headings and #C4D6D0 subtitles.

The deployment build compiled frontend/.env's preview REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL into main.70539878.js. Packaging must use deployment-specific same-origin configuration rather than the preview testing environment.

yarn build succeeds, but DashboardPages.jsx and RoleDashboards.jsx still emit react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings for loadMine/loadProjects (and RoleDashboards loadListings); these are pre-existing maintainability risks rather than failures of this CSS fix.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested live UI fixes/regressions and packaged CSS pass; deployment API target and button AA contrast fail)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeded user and developer accounts were used; no records were created, modified, archived, or deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live public preview passed user login, light/dark dash-list-property-cta computed styles, dark sidebar/headings/empty states, Overview/My Listings/Profile & Security tab switching, developer login and light/dark dev-listing-banner styles using the real footer theme toggle, and homepage light-mode header/hero sanity. No console, page, HTTP, or visible error elements occurred in final runs. yarn build succeeded with warnings. Zip CRC, cache/secret/node_modules exclusions, and packaged dark gradient CSS rules pass. Packaged JS contains one preview-domain reference and must be rebuilt for same-origin deployment.
rca_of_the_issue: The visual defect is fixed because dark mode now overrides both Tailwind gradient stops, matching the existing dark text overrides. The remaining deployment regression occurs because CRA compiles REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env at build time; the archive's main.70539878.js therefore contains the preview host instead of using /api. Reproduce with: unzip -p /app/production-hostinger-ready.zip 'frontend/build/static/js/*.js' | grep -o 'realtor-uploader.preview.emergentagent.com'.
